description: CX version 1 (the NDEx and Cytoscape exchange format): real files from ndex2-client, cx2js, ndex-object-model, RCX and NDEx, and the authored groups, collection and edge-case set of research-cx.md

the old aspect name visualProperties, no layout, list_of_string aliases
a Cytoscape export with every scalar type, pre and post metadata, cyTableColumn with empty columns, integer coordinates
edges in two fragments, the first before nodes (forward references)
